outcome: Pulmonary protein expression and localization of TSP1
Pulmonary protein expression and localization of CD47
Pulmonary protein expression and localization of Runx3
cohort: Fetuses from a nitrofen-induced congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) rat model.
finding: The CDH group showed significantly increased relative mRNA expression and overexpression of pulmonary TSP1, CD47, and Runx3 on D21 compared to the control group.
gest_age: D17, D19, and D21 of gestation
